purpose: Discover source SAE addition-table components without task gradients and test their causal numeric selectivity
budget: At most1800driver seconds for300arithmetic states and30source components across10existingSAEs. No target fitting, new weights or training.
scope: Source development on the complete0..9addition grid and3fixed prompt templates. Feature groups are chosen only by standardized activation contrast for sums6/9/12 using template0 and a hash-selected operand fit subset. Causal evaluation uses held operand pairs of template0 and all pairs in the2new templates; repeated operand pairs across templates are dependent. No language-model output or gradient chooses source members. Actual source numeric-output selectivity is measured before any target relation is fit. Arithmetic prompts are our controlled probe, not an official benchmark.
precision: highest throughout; source/native maps and every actual model forward recomputed with consistent full float32 matrix multiplication. No R25 cached hidden values reused.
consumer_statistics_unit: Five disjoint source-target pairs per mechanism conditional on prior source selection; old exposed generated grammar pairs. Development summaries, not population confirmation.
